class.name: FoundryBuildResult
class.brief_description: Result returned by a script-backed Foundry build task.
class.description: Contains the high-level result of [method FoundryBuildTask.run], any requested [FoundryBuildCommand] objects, command output, diagnostics, and the task fingerprint used by build scheduling.

members.member: The command descriptors requested by the task. Entries are expected to be [FoundryBuildCommand] instances.
Structured diagnostic dictionaries produced by the task.
The process exit code for command-backed tasks, or [code]-1[/code] when the process could not complete normally.
Hash of command inputs that affect whether the task is considered dirty.
Error text captured when the command process could not be launched.
Standard error captured from command-backed tasks.
Standard output captured from command-backed tasks.
Whether the command process exceeded its configured timeout.
